_why: Commits this package legitimately DISCUSSES but was not produced from. head-consistency.py refuses any other SHA in a claim-bearing member, so a stale head from a superseded round cannot appear silently. Every entry here is a deliberate mention with its reason. The head, the parent and the commits between them are not listed: they are what this package IS, and they are derived rather than named. There is no entry for the review this lane answers, because that review has no published commit — see HANDOFF.md and PROVENANCE.md.

commits.fd5a1579d724069a06adca39b0a363064a212b1b: The V13 evidence commit on evidence/catena-e1-corrections-v13-handoff, carrying the immutable handoff of the head this lane corrects. Named so the chain from the reviewed package to this correction is followable without the reviewer reconstructing it.
commits.ac4b9d608f52e23f199c4b3149c73e5fb14c3d59: Current origin/main at the time of this lane, recorded so a reviewer can see this candidate is not integrated with it and does not overlap it on any Catena path.
commits.728c3e3b3d0d6e899f0da33e06a08a116375896f: The V12 independent review, on review/catena-wave-1-e1-corrections-v12-independent. Named where this lane cites a decision that review made and the V13 review left standing — the page-wide fail-closed contamination policy accepted as a design. Not the review this lane answers.
commits.0965ca5ed6982a570427ae00e14a5bb7b38143bd: Not a commit: the V13 package's ZIP SHA-256, at 1,306,976 bytes, quoted so the artifact this lane supersedes is identified by its bytes rather than by its name alone.
commits.733e84909e0e8049629187352d3800be320e469d: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/catena.css, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no stylesheet changed.
commits.7779d1f19ca175fd315cd7164f5347cc3c08d68b: Not a commit: the SHA-256 of src/web/browser/catena/index.html, byte-identical at both endpoints, quoted where this package claims no markup changed.
commits.cfa1b5fa5e415ed0cf9574cb4a8e5a03cd2629bf: A superseded head of this same lane. A head battery ran green against it and was SET ASIDE rather than deleted when comparing its full discovery with the parent's showed one inherited error at the parent that this head did not have, so a sentence in the durable records claiming the two inherited sets were identical was corrected and the head moved. It appears only in the append-only attempt ledger's set-aside row and its reason, which is where a cohort that ran and was not used belongs.
